src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: at-large (one U.S. House seat for the whole state)
U.S. Census Bureau cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k: one record for South Dakota

South Dakota has had one House seat since the 1990 census, so there is no congressional plan; the whole state is the district. Census check: cb_2020_us_cd116 holds one record for the state, so the map is the whole state.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2011 legislative plan (2011 special session, SL 2011 (SS) ch 1): 35 districts
South Dakota Codified Laws 2-2-42 (Senate districts), source line: SL 2011 (SS), ch 1, effective Jan. 23, 2012; SL 2021 (1SS), ch 1, effective Feb. 9, 2022

Passed in the Oct. 2011 special session; the act took effect Jan. 23, 2012, ahead of the 2012 elections. One senator and two representatives per district. Used for the 2012 through 2020 elections. Census check: cb_2020_us_sldu (LSY 2018, 35 districts; boundaries collected for the 2018 election year) holds this plan, which was unchanged to November 2020; 32 of 35 districts differ in shape from the 2022 file.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2011 legislative plan (2011 special session, SL 2011 (SS) ch 1): 35 districts, two representatives each; Districts 26 and 28 are split into one-member subdistricts 26A, 26B, 28A, 28B
South Dakota Codified Laws 2-2-42 (Senate districts), source line: SL 2011 (SS), ch 1, effective Jan. 23, 2012; SL 2021 (1SS), ch 1, effective Feb. 9, 2022

Census file has 37 House records (33 whole districts plus 26A, 26B, 28A, 28B). Used for the 2012 through 2020 elections. Census check: cb_2020_us_sldl (LSY 2018, 37 districts; boundaries collected for the 2018 election year) holds this plan, which was unchanged to November 2020; 34 of 37 districts differ in shape from the 2022 file.
